messages:
maya: Morning poll — which is a worse omen for your day: (1) office microwave burnt fish smell, (2) 3-way merge conflict, (3) segfault in prod, (4) printer jam? Vote with emoji.
sam: :one: microwave takes the crown. It haunts the dev kitchen for days.
hyun: :three: segfault in prod. Can't even explain that to PMs. :sweat_smile:
anya: Honestly printer jams are so elite at 9am. :printer:
diego: lol here is a classic segfault log snippet i found yesterday:
```
#0 0x00000000 in ?? ()
#1 0x7f8b0c1ed7b3 in main (/usr/bin/myservice)
SIGSEGV at address 0x0
```
ops-bot: Incident created: #inc-2026-042 — assigned to eng-oncall.
maya: Tally so far: microwave 2, segfault 2, printer 1, merge conflict 0 — tie! but microwave stays on top in spirit. :fish:
sam: Next step — mandatory microwave rule: use a lid, or you owe the team lunch. :stew:
hyun: Also small PSA: label your Tupperware. We had tuna vs jam incident. :grimacing:
anya: kudos @sam for rescuing the printer yesterday :trophy:
diego: can we also try a 'no-fish Friday'? :pray:
maya: noted. I'll add a sticky note on the fridge. :memo:
